result.message: Testing stage. You will be given 2 test inputs, one at a time and answered separately. Apply the same transformation rule to each and submit the predicted output grid with submit_final_answer.

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==3]
    # The two congruent diagonal shapes are extended by the same knight displacement.
    # Identify upper-right and lower-left components; apply to every occupied cell.
    if pts:
        # use each 3: upper portion gets (-1,-2), lower gets (+1,+2)
        mr=sum(r for r,c in pts)/len(pts)
        mc=sum(c for r,c in pts)/len(pts)
        for r,c in pts:
            dr,dc=((-1,-2) if (r<mr and c>mc) else (1,2))
            rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=rr<len(out) and 0<=cc<len(out[0]) and out[rr][cc]==0:
                out[rr][cc]=8
    return out"}

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==3]
    if not pts: return out
    mr=sum(r for r,c in pts)/len(pts)
    upper=[(r,c) for r,c in pts if r<mr]
    lower=[(r,c) for r,c in pts if r>mr]
    if not upper or not lower: return out
    cu=sum(c for r,c in upper)/len(upper)
    cl=sum(c for r,c in lower)/len(lower)
    dc=2 if cl>cu else -2
    for r,c in upper:
        rr,cc=r-1,c+dc
        if 0<=rr<len(out) and 0<=cc<len(out[0]) and out[rr][cc]==0: out[rr][cc]=8
    for r,c in lower:
        rr,cc=r+1,c-dc
        if 0<=rr<len(out) and 0<=cc<len(out[0]) and out[rr][cc]==0: out[rr][cc]=8
    return out"}
